ugreenctl 0.2.0 - UGREEN NAS Hardware Management Utility

Usage:
  ugreenctl [options] models

  ugreenctl led set <targets...> --color <blue|#RRGGBB|R,G,B>
              [--brightness <0-255|N%>] [--mode on|off|blink|breath]
              [--on-ms N --off-ms N] [--force --apply]

  --model <id>        use a specific model plugin
  --plugin-dir <dir>  directory containing model .so files

  --json              structured output for LED/disk commands
  --version           print the version
  --help              print this help

a guarded direct Super I/O fallback is available only with no active owner.
Writes require an exact DMI match and always select manual PWM mode.

ugreenctl 0.2.0 - UGREEN NAS Hardware Management Utility

Usage:
  ugreenctl [options] models
  ugreenctl [options] info
  ugreenctl [options] thermal status
  ugreenctl [options] fan status
  ugreenctl [options] fan set <fan-id> <0-255>
  ugreenctl [options] power startup get
  ugreenctl [options] power startup set <on|off|restore>
  ugreenctl [options] power rtc-wake get
  ugreenctl [options] power rtc-wake set <unix-epoch>
  ugreenctl [options] power rtc-wake clear
  ugreenctl [options] network wol get
  ugreenctl [options] network wol set <on|off>
  ugreenctl led list
  ugreenctl led status [all|power|netdev|diskN...] [--json]
  ugreenctl led set <targets...> --color <blue|#RRGGBB|R,G,B>
              [--brightness <0-255|N%>] [--mode on|off|blink|breath]
              [--on-ms N --off-ms N] [--force --apply]
  ugreenctl led on|off <targets...> [--force --apply]
  ugreenctl led identify <target> [--seconds N] [--force --apply]
  ugreenctl disk list|map [--json]
  ugreenctl disk locate <device|serial|slotN> [--seconds N] [--force --apply]

Options (LED/disk options may also follow the command):
  --model <id>        use a specific model plugin
  --plugin-dir <dir>  directory containing model .so files
  --apply             perform a requested write (writes are dry runs otherwise)
  --force             acknowledge an experimental model write
  --json              structured output for LED/disk commands
  --version           print the version
  --help              print this help

Fan control prefers the Linux hwmon node named it8613. If it is absent,
a guarded direct Super I/O fallback is available only with no active owner.
Writes require an exact DMI match and always select manual PWM mode.
